prompt: An ALM plan for an AI solution versions only the agent definition. According to the learning content, which additional data artifacts must be treated as versioned, promotable ALM artifacts?

options.text: Training and evaluation datasets, grounding knowledge, prompt assets, policies and guardrails, and run telemetry
The production database backup and the agent's conversation transcripts, retained for the regulatory period
The Teams app manifest, icons, and publishing metadata, versioned together with the Copilot Studio solution package
The vendor's model weights and the model catalog entry, which must be re-downloaded for each environment

explanation: Scope der „Daten“ im AI-ALM: Trainings-/Fine-Tuning-Datasets, Evaluations-/Golden-Sets, Grounding-Wissen, Prompt-Assets, Policies/Guardrails (DLP, Labels, Connectors, Action-Limits) und Run-Telemetrie plus Feedback.

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: Treat the following as versioned, promotable ALM artifacts:

prompt: A data engineer keeps editing the evaluation dataset in production to "keep it fresh". Which environment pattern from the learning content does this violate?

options.text: The red-gold pattern, where red data is mutable and experimental, gold datasets are frozen, and production uses gold only
The canary pattern, where new datasets are released to a small, isolated subset of users before the full rollout to production
The hybrid search pattern, where vector and keyword indexes are combined and re-ranked by a semantic ranker
The sidecar pattern, where the evaluation data sits next to the application and is refreshed on the same schedule

explanation: Je Umgebung eigene Datenebenen: Dev (Red, veränderlich) → Test → Pre-Prod (Gold-Kandidaten) → Prod (nur Gold). Gold-Sets werden eingefroren mit Immutability-Attestierung; Promotion Gates verlangen Qualitätsreports, Bias-Checks, Lineage und Security-Signoff.

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: Red gold datasets pattern: red (mutable, experimental) vs. gold (frozen, promoted).

prompt: Match each promotion gate in the AI data ALM process to the evidence the learning content requires.

left.text: Gate A to B (catalog and ownership)
Gate B to C (data quality and lineage)
Gate C to D (evaluation and safety)
Gate D to E (compliance and residency)

right.text: Data contract, catalog record, and label policy proof
Profiling report, lineage graph, and version IDs
Metrics pack, safety report, and model or data card
Residency mapping, DLP rules, and approval memo

explanation: Gate-Tabelle: A→B Katalog/Ownership (Data Contract, Katalogeintrag, Label-Nachweis), B→C Qualität/Lineage (Profiling, Lineage-Graph, Versions-IDs), C→D Evaluation/Safety (Metrics Pack, Safety Report, Model/Data Card), D→E Compliance/Residency (Residency-Mapping, DLP, Approval), E→F Runtime Readiness (Dashboards, Alarme, Rollback, Budget Guard).

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: Metrics pack; safety report; model/data card

prompt: During the Develop and Evaluate phase, a team wants to fine-tune directly on the production knowledge base to save time. What does the learning content state?

options.text: Train and iterate using Dev and Test data, evaluate on golden sets, and keep production knowledge out of training
Production data is preferred for fine-tuning because it is the most current and reflects real user behavior and vocabulary
Training on production knowledge is acceptable if canary runs with masked data follow before the release
Foundry agents may train on production knowledge, while Copilot Studio agents must use Dev and Test data

explanation: Phase C: mit Dev/Test-Daten trainieren und iterieren, nie mit Produktionswissen; Evaluationssuiten (Accuracy, Safety, Robustness, Cost) auf Golden Sets; Model/Data Cards speichern.

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: Train/iterate using Dev/Test data; never train on production knowledge.

prompt: A regulated bank's Copilot feature needs cross-region capacity because in-region capacity is unavailable. Following the residency decision tree in the learning content, what should happen?

options.text: Check whether overflow is allowed for this workload tier; if yes, enable cross-region processing under admin control, else block or defer
Enable cross-region processing automatically for the feature, since availability outranks residency for productivity workloads in the tenant
Move the whole tenant to a geography with available capacity and migrate the mailbox region of the affected users
Disable the Copilot feature permanently for the bank, because any cross-region processing violates the residency policy

explanation: In regulierten Szenarien ist In-Region der Default; Overflow braucht explizite Freigabe. Entscheidungsbaum: In-Region-Kapazität vorhanden? Ja → lokal. Nein → Overflow für diese Workload-Stufe erlaubt? Ja → Cross-Region unter Admin-Kontrolle; sonst blockieren oder verschieben.

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: In regulated scenarios, set the default to in-region and require explicit approval to enable overflow processing.

prompt: In the Operate and Monitor phase, live metrics for an agent drift beyond the per-release baseline. What response does the learning content prescribe?

options.text: Auto-open an incident, route it to the data owner, and pause affected actions
Retrain the model immediately on live production prompts and redeploy it
Raise the drift threshold so that the alert stops firing and review it next quarter
Delete the baseline and start a new one from the current live data

explanation: Baseline-Metriken je Release (Latenz p95, Erfolg, Token/€, Safety Flags); überschreitet Drift die Schwellen: Incident automatisch öffnen, an Data Owner routen, betroffene Aktionen pausieren; Evaluationssuiten regelmäßig gegen Golden Sets.

source.title: Design an ALM process for data used in AI models and agents
source.quote: Compare live to baseline; if drift exceeds thresholds, auto-open an incident, route to data owner, and pause affected actions.

prompt: An architect designs the environment strategy for Copilot Studio agents, connectors, and actions. Evaluate each statement against the learning content.

statements.text: At least three environments are needed: Development, Test, and Production.
Managed solutions should be used only in Test and Production, with no direct editing in Production.
Knowledge sources should be added directly in Production to ensure they are current.
Connectors should be published to Production before authentication flows are validated to speed up delivery.

explanation: Mindestens Dev/Test/Prod; keine Direktbearbeitung in Prod; Managed Solutions nur in Test/Prod; Solution Layering. Wissensquellen in Dev hinzufügen; Connector-Release: Author → Auth validieren → DLP → Security-Freigabe → Publish to Prod.

source.title: Design an ALM process for Copilot Studio agents, connectors, and actions
source.quote: Managed solutions only in Test and Prod

prompt: Arrange the steps of the connector release flow from the learning content in order.
explanation: Connector Release Flow: Author → Validate Auth → Apply DLP → Approve Security → Publish to Prod. Connectors werden nur in Dev gebaut und erst nach vollständigem Review in Prod veröffentlicht.

source.title: Design an ALM process for Copilot Studio agents, connectors, and actions
source.quote: Author → Validate Auth → Apply DLP → Approve Security → Publish to Prod

prompt: A Foundry agent is about to be promoted from Test to Production. Which checks does the learning content assign to this second promotion gate?

options.text: Regression completion, compliance approval, performance and cost assessment, human validation of reasoning, and documentation of version and risk
Functional validation of core behaviors, initial safety and guardrail checks, and a review of the action, connector, and data source configuration
Verification of data source mappings, code or prompt quality review, and confirmation that the agent runs in the Dev environment
Selection of the Foundry model catalog entry, registration of the agent identity, and assignment of the agent owner in the registry

explanation: Gate 1 (Dev → Test): funktionale Validierung, erste Safety-Checks, Datenquellen-Mapping, Connector-Review, Code-/Prompt-Qualität. Gate 2 (Test → Prod): Regression, Compliance-Freigabe, Performance/Kosten, menschliche Validierung des Reasonings, Dokumentation von Version, Abhängigkeiten, Risiko.

source.title: Design ALM processes for Microsoft Foundry agents
source.quote: Human validation of agent reasoning

prompt: A team hot-fixes prompts of a Foundry agent directly in Production. Which versioning principle from the learning content is violated?

options.text: Treat each agent as a versioned artifact, keep production releases immutable, and promote only versioned bundles
Register the agent in the Microsoft 365 app catalog so that each prompt change is reviewed by the tenant admin first
Use the Python SDK instead of the portal, because portal edits are not tracked by the Foundry control plane
Store the prompts in SharePoint rather than in the agent, so that they can be edited without a redeployment

explanation: Versioning Principles: Agent als versioniertes Artefakt, unveränderliche Produktions-Releases, Changelogs, nur versionierte Bundles promoten. Der Foundry Control Plane bietet zentrale Übersicht über Definitionen, Sicherheitskontext und Datenquellen.

source.title: Design ALM processes for Microsoft Foundry agents
source.quote: Promote only versioned bundles across environments.

prompt: In the Evaluation and Approval stage of the custom model ALM lifecycle, which artifact does the learning content require to document metrics, constraints, and recommended usage boundaries?

options.text: A Model Card
A Teams app manifest
A DLP policy export
A landing zone blueprint

explanation: Evaluation & Approval: Genauigkeit, Relevanz, Zuverlässigkeit, Fehlerbehandlung, Kosten/Latenz/Throughput, Safety prüfen und eine Model Card mit Metriken, Constraints und Nutzungsgrenzen erstellen; die Gate-Checkliste verlangt die Model Card ausdrücklich.

source.title: Design an ALM process for custom AI models
source.quote: Produce a Model Card containing metrics, constraints, and recommended usage boundaries.

prompt: A custom model no longer meets accuracy and cost expectations. Which retirement steps does the learning content prescribe?

options.text: Decommission the version, archive data, artifacts, and evaluation logs, and document the transition to the next version
Delete the artifacts and evaluation logs immediately to reduce storage cost and remove the model from the registry and catalog
Keep serving the model in production until a vendor replacement is purchased, and lower the accuracy threshold
Retrain the model on production prompts without re-evaluation and promote it directly to the production endpoint

explanation: Retirement: Version stilllegen, Daten/Artefakte/Evaluationslogs archivieren, Übergangsplan zur nächsten Version dokumentieren. Audit Trails und Lineage bleiben für Compliance erhalten.

source.title: Design an ALM process for custom AI models
source.quote: Archive data, artifacts, evaluation logs.

topic: ALM for AI in Finance and Supply Chain
prompt: An ALM design for AI in Dynamics 365 Finance hard-codes the model endpoint and connection strings in the solution. Which key requirement from the learning content does this break?

options.text: Use environment variables for endpoints, model names, and connection strings
Train the model on live financial postings taken from the production ledger
Allow direct edits in Production for emergency fixes to the prompts
Share one curated dataset across Dev, Test, and Prod for consistency

explanation: Key Requirements: keine Direktbearbeitung in Prod, Environment Variables für Endpunkte, Modellnamen und Connection Strings, getrennte Datenquellen inkl. synthetischer Testdaten. Gate 2 verlangt u. a. Residency-Review und Freigabe durch Architektur/Governance.

source.title: Design an ALM process for AI in Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain
source.quote: Use environment variables for endpoints, model names, and connection strings.

prompt: A Supply Chain AI agent can post journals and approve purchase orders. Which risk control from the learning content applies specifically to such business-critical processes?

options.text: Guardrails for business-critical processes such as posting journals and approving purchase orders, with DLP rules for AI actions
Removal of security roles for the agent identity so that journal postings and approvals are not blocked by permissions
Disabling data residency checks for ERP data, because supply chain postings have to be processed in the nearest region
Publishing Dataverse virtual entities as knowledge sources so that the agent can validate purchase orders before approval and posting

explanation: Risk & Compliance Controls: Residency für Finanzdaten, Sensitivity Labels, DLP für AI-Aktionen und Guardrails für geschäftskritische Prozesse (Journalbuchungen, PO-Genehmigungen). Monitoring deckt Prediction Drift und Data Drift ab.

source.title: Design an ALM process for AI in Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain
source.quote: Guardrails for business-critical processes (e.g., posting journals, approving purchase orders)

topic: ALM for AI in customer engagement apps
prompt: Which environment tier does the learning content add for AI in Dynamics 365 customer experience and service apps beyond Dev, Test, and Prod, and what is it for?

options.text: Pre-Production (UAT) to validate business acceptance, performance, safety, and compliance against live-like queues and knowledge
A Sandbox tier where makers edit production data freely to reproduce customer issues before they are fixed in Dev
A Training tier where summarization and classification models are fine-tuned on live cases before promotion to Prod
A Marketing tier for customer demos, populated with anonymized cases and refreshed from production with each release wave

explanation: Empfohlene Struktur: DEV (Prompts, Workflows, Mappings), TEST (realistische Datasets, Regression), PRE-PROD/UAT (Business Acceptance, Performance, Safety, Compliance mit live-ähnlichen Queues) und PROD. Deployment über Managed Solutions und Pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

source.title: Design ALM processes for AI in Dynamics 365 apps
source.quote: Test integration with live-like customer service queues, interactions, and knowledge entities.

prompt: A high-risk AI release for Dynamics 365 Customer Service changes routing rules and case summarization prompts. Which audit and traceability control does the learning content require?

options.text: Change Advisory Board reviews for high-risk AI releases, with tracked prompt versions, decision logs, and mapping changes
Deployment by the maker alone without a review, provided that the prompt regression tests passed in the Test environment beforehand
An email announcement to the service managers after deployment, with a summary of the changed routing rules
A vendor sign-off instead of an internal review, because the routing rules are part of the Microsoft-managed solution

explanation: Audit & Traceability: Prompt-Versionen, Entscheidungslogs, Mapping-Änderungen, Agent-Updates tracken; CAB-Reviews für risikoreiche AI-Releases. Dazu Responsible-AI-Controls (Least Privilege, DLP, Labels) und Residency.

source.title: Design ALM processes for AI in Dynamics 365 apps
source.quote: Establish CAB (Change Advisory Board) reviews for high-risk AI releases.

prompt: A helpdesk triage agent stores a service-account password in its configuration to call Azure resources. Which identity design from the learning content fixes this?

options.text: Assign a managed identity per agent and environment to remove secrets, with least-privilege roles at the narrowest scope
Share one global identity across the agents to simplify administration, and store its password in Azure Key Vault
Rotate the service-account password weekly and keep it in the agent's instructions so that the maker can update it
Grant the agent Owner rights on the subscription so that authorization does not fail, and review the audit log monthly

explanation: Jeder Agent, jedes Tool und jede Pipeline bekommt eine eigene Identität je Umgebung mit Ownership-Metadaten; Managed Identities statt Secrets; Least Privilege auf engster Scope-Ebene; Separation of Duties (Maker, Publisher, Environment Admin, Security Admin).

source.title: Design security agents for Microsoft clouds
source.quote: Prefer managed identities for agent-to-Azure authentication to remove secrets and simplify rotation.

prompt: An agent reads tickets on behalf of the signed-in user but also runs a nightly summarization job as itself. Which authorization pattern does the learning content prescribe for the two modes?

options.text: Propagate the user's permissions when acting on behalf of a user; scope a service role with the required actions when acting as itself
Use the maker's personal credentials for both modes, because the maker already has access to the tickets and the summary location
Give the agent full tenant permissions so that both modes work without additional configuration, and restrict access in the instructions
Run the nightly job under the user who last signed in, so that the summarization inherits a real user's permissions each night

explanation: Authorization Patterns: Least Privilege mit engen Rollen; bei Handeln im Namen eines Nutzers dessen Berechtigungen propagieren; bei Handeln als sich selbst eine Service-Rolle mit nur den nötigen Aktionen.

source.title: Design security agents for Microsoft clouds
source.quote: When an agent acts on behalf of a user, propagate the user's permissions; when it acts as itself, scope a service role with only the actions the agent needs.

prompt: Which two items from the learning content's agent security design checklist relate to threat protection and assurance? (Choose two.)

options.text: AI-specific threat protection and output moderation enabled
Red team performed and open risks addressed
Prompt library stored in SharePoint
Model router configured with weighted routing
Savings calculator configured per tool

explanation: Threat Protection & Assurance: KI-bewusste Bedrohungserkennung (Prompt-Manipulation, Leakage), Input-/Output-Filter, Red-Team-Bewertungen vor Produktion und nach großen Änderungen mit Release-Gate auf Findings, Incident Response mit Deaktivierung, Log-Erhalt und Drills.

source.title: Design security agents for Microsoft clouds
source.quote: Run red team evaluations pre-production and after major changes; gate releases on findings closure.

prompt: Dozens of agents exist across environments and nobody can say who owns which one or what data each accesses. Which governance element does the learning content prescribe?

options.text: An agent registry documenting purpose, environment, risk level, and data access, with an assigned owner and publishing approvals
A single shared identity for the agents so that ownership is unambiguous and each data access is attributed to one account and owner
Deleting every agent older than six months and requiring teams to rebuild the ones they still need in a new environment
A monthly newsletter listing new agents and their makers, so that teams can discover and reuse existing agents

explanation: Accountability und Ownership: Agent Owner je Agent (Lifecycle, Sicherheitslage, Freigaben), Agent Registry (Zweck, Umgebung, Risiko, Datenzugriff), Publishing-Freigaben für Agenten mit sensiblen oder regulierten Daten.

source.title: Design governance models for AI agents
source.quote: Maintain an agent registry documenting purpose, environment, risk level, and data access.

prompt: An agent calls external APIs. Which rules does the learning content set for governing such integrations?

options.text: Allow only approved connectors and endpoints, validate authentication and scope, and ensure external data flows comply with policy
Allow any endpoint as long as it uses HTTPS and the agent's instructions list the systems it is permitted to call
Route all external calls through the maker's personal account so that every call is attributed to a named person
Disable logging for external calls to reduce noise, and review the connector usage report in the admin center once a quarter

explanation: Govern external integrations: nur freigegebene Connectors/Endpunkte, Auth-Methoden und Scope validieren, externe Datenflüsse im Einklang mit Policy und Verträgen. Ergänzend Runtime Protection, Input-/Output-Filter und Integration in Security Monitoring.

source.title: Design governance models for AI agents
source.quote: Allow only approved connectors and endpoints.

prompt: Which lifecycle policies does the learning content say must govern agents as they evolve?

options.text: Scheduled reviews for accuracy, freshness, and risk; criteria for archiving or retiring unused agents; controlled deployment pipelines
Unlimited retention of each agent version in production, so that any earlier behavior can be restored on request
Automatic promotion of any agent that passes a single functional test, so that teams are not slowed down by reviews
Annual replacement of the agents regardless of performance, so that outdated instructions and knowledge do not accumulate over time

explanation: Lifecycle Policies: geplante Reviews (Genauigkeit, Datenfrische, Risiko), Kriterien für Archivierung/Retirement ungenutzter Agenten, kontrollierte Deployment-Pipelines; dazu Standard-Templates, Versionskontrolle und verpflichtende Pre-Publish-Checks.

source.title: Design governance models for AI agents
source.quote: Criteria for archiving or retiring unused agents.

prompt: Arrange the steps of the model hardening blueprint from the learning content in order.
explanation: Blueprint: 1 Secure Compute, 2 Private Endpoints, 3 Threat Protection, 4 Validation Pipeline, 5 Monitoring and Drift Detection. Dazu Managed Identities, RBAC, Datenminimierung, Verschlüsselung, Residency und DLP.

source.title: Design model security for responsible AI
source.quote: Continuously monitor model performance and identify data or model drift.

prompt: A retraining pipeline ingests newly crawled documents automatically. Which safeguard against model drift and poisoning does the learning content require?

options.text: Track data lineage for all training sources and validate newly introduced data before using it in retraining
Retrain more frequently so that any bad data is diluted by the volume of correctly crawled documents
Disable anomaly detection during retraining to avoid false alarms caused by the new document distribution
Expose the training endpoint publicly so that partners can contribute documents directly to the retraining pipeline

explanation: Model drift and poisoning safeguards: Lineage für alle Trainingsquellen, Validierung neuer Daten vor Retraining, automatisierte Anomalieerkennung im Modellverhalten. Infrastruktur: isolierte Netze, Private Endpoints, sichere Build-Pipelines.

source.title: Design model security for responsible AI
source.quote: Validate newly introduced data before using it in retraining pipelines.

prompt: A model endpoint is suspected to be compromised. Which incident response steps does the learning content predefine for AI models?

options.text: Disable the compromised endpoint, preserve inference logs and model artifacts for forensics, and roll back to a prior version
Delete the inference logs and artifacts to prevent further leakage, and redeploy the same model version to a new endpoint
Keep the endpoint running until a root cause is confirmed, so that the forensic team can observe the attack in progress
Retrain the model immediately on the suspicious traffic so that it learns to reject the inputs, and skip the rollback

explanation: Incident Response für Modelle: Schritte zum Deaktivieren des Endpunkts vordefinieren, Inferenzlogs und Artefakte für Forensik bewahren, Rollback-Prozeduren für frühere Versionen; Alerts in SOC-Workflows routen.

source.title: Design model security for responsible AI
source.quote: Preserve inference logs and model artifacts for forensic analysis.

prompt: Match each observed weakness to the AI vulnerability category defined in the learning content.

left.text: A user writes "ignore previous instructions" and the agent discloses restricted data
Transcripts and memory stores hold unprotected sensitive data
A misconfigured connector lets users escalate privileges through the agent
Autonomous tool use runs without guardrails or rollback capability

explanation: Kategorien: Prompt Manipulation (Instruktionen überschreiben, täuschender Kontext, versteckte Anweisungen in Dateien), Model Behavior (Fabrikation, Toxizität, Bias), Data Exposure (Logs/Memory, zu weite Rechte), Identity/RBAC Gaps (Eskalation über Connectors), Agent/Workflow (ungesicherte Tool-Nutzung, fehlendes Audit/Rollback).

source.title: Analyze AI vulnerabilities and mitigations for prompt manipulation
source.quote: Escalate privileges through misconfigured connectors or plugins.

prompt: Users upload files that contain embedded instructions aimed at the agent. Which two mitigations from the learning content's input and output filtering guidance apply? (Choose two.)

options.text: Strip unsafe HTML or embedded prompts
Limit the file types the AI may accept
Increase the model's context window so it can read the whole file
Grant the agent elevated privileges to process files faster
Disable safety filters on outputs to avoid false positives

explanation: Input/Output Filtering: Code-Ausführungsversuche blockieren, unsicheres HTML oder eingebettete Prompts entfernen, Safety-Filter auf Outputs, erlaubte Dateitypen begrenzen. Layered Defense kombiniert Identität, Data Governance, Evaluation, Monitoring und Incident Response.

source.title: Analyze AI vulnerabilities and mitigations for prompt manipulation
source.quote: Strip unsafe HTML or embedded prompts.

prompt: Why does the learning content recommend a layered approach to mitigating AI vulnerabilities?

options.text: A layered approach reduces single-point failure risk by combining identity, data governance, evaluation, monitoring, and incident response
A single, well-tuned content filter on the model output is sufficient, because prompt attacks surface in the generated text sooner or later
Layered defenses eliminate the need for monitoring and incident response, because each layer blocks the attack before it lands
Managed identities alone block prompt injection, so the remaining layers mainly serve compliance documentation purposes

explanation: Layered Defense: Identitäts-/Zugriffsgrenzen, sichere Data Governance, Modellevaluation und Tests, Monitoring/Anomalieerkennung, Incident-Response-Bereitschaft; so vermeidet man Single Points of Failure.

source.title: Analyze AI vulnerabilities and mitigations for prompt manipulation
source.quote: A layered approach reduces single-point failure risk

prompt: An architect leads a cross-disciplinary Responsible AI review of a customer-facing agent. Which review areas does the learning content's structured model include?

options.text: Purpose and intended use, data privacy and security, model and agent behavior, fairness and bias, transparency, validation tools, and oversight
A legal review of the terms of service, the data processing agreement with the model vendor, and the customer-facing disclaimer and consent text
A performance benchmark against competitor products, covering accuracy, latency, and cost per conversation for the same scenarios
A review of license costs, GPU utilization, and token consumption, with a recommendation on the model tier for the next quarter

explanation: Strukturierter RAI-Review: Zweck/Intended Use, Daten/Privacy/Security, Modell- und Agentenverhalten (Fabrikation, Prompt-Adhärenz, Fallback), Fairness/Bias, Transparenz/UX (Offenlegung, Grenzen, Eskalation), RAI-Validierungstools, operative Oversight (Incident Plan, Drift, Governance Board, Sunset-Kriterien).

source.title: Review solution adherence to Responsible AI principles
source.quote: Responsible AI is not a one-time review—it requires continuous monitoring.

prompt: During a Responsible AI review, the team checks the agent's user interface. Which transparency requirements does the learning content list?

options.text: AI involvement is clearly communicated, users understand the limitations, documentation and escalation paths are accessible, and feedback is logged
The model name and version are hidden to protect intellectual property, while the agent's capabilities and limits are described in the help center
The agent presents itself as a human representative to increase trust, and the AI disclosure is placed in the terms of service
Feedback controls are disabled to keep the interface simple, and limitations are communicated through the onboarding training

explanation: Transparency and user experience: KI-Beteiligung klar kommunizieren, Grenzen verständlich machen, Zugang zu Dokumentation, Verhaltensübersichten und Eskalationspfaden, Feedback-Logging für kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

source.title: Review solution adherence to Responsible AI principles
source.quote: AI involvement is clearly communicated

prompt: A compliance team must confirm that a Copilot Studio agent keeps customer data in-region. Which validation points does the learning content list for Copilot Studio?

options.text: Where prompts are processed, whether unpublished agents and preview features follow different rules, how connector data is stored, and whether cross-region interactions occur
The physical location of the tenant admin, the region of the maker's Copilot Studio license, and the language settings of the agent's channels
The number of knowledge sources per agent, the size of each uploaded file, the retention period of the Dataverse tables used for grounding, and the channel list
The agent's icon and display name, the authentication provider, and the Teams app catalog in which the agent is published

explanation: Copilot Studio setzt regionale Grenzen je Umgebungskonfiguration durch; Architekten prüfen Verarbeitungsort der Prompts, abweichende Regeln für unveröffentlichte/Preview-Features, Speicherung bei Connectors/Plugins und Cross-Region-Interaktionen. Purview-Labels und DLP ergänzen die Kontrolle.

source.title: Validate data residency and movement compliance
source.quote: Whether unpublished agents and preview features follow different residency rules.

prompt: A bank wants to stop sensitive data from being used in Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts or outputs and restrict cross-region transmission. Which Purview controls does the learning content recommend?

options.text: Sensitivity labels restricting cross-tenant or cross-region transmission, DLP rules preventing sensitive data in prompts or outputs, and auditing
A longer retention period for Copilot interaction logs and a monthly export of the prompts to the bank's data lake for review
A separate tenant per department with its own Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and a dedicated Graph index
Disabling Microsoft Graph for the users so that Copilot can no longer ground on mail, files, or chats

explanation: Purview: Sensitivity Labels gegen Cross-Tenant/Cross-Region-Übertragung, DLP-Regeln gegen sensible Daten in Prompts/Outputs, Auditing und Policy Insights prüfen, Residency der Copilot-Interaktionslogs validieren.

source.title: Validate data residency and movement compliance
source.quote: Use data loss prevention (DLP) rules to prevent sensitive data from being used in AI prompts or outputs.

prompt: An architect documents how grounding data reaches the model securely. Which retrieval access flow does the learning content describe?

options.text: Prompt, then policy check, then search index, then sanitization layer, then model context injection
Prompt, then model context injection, then search index, then policy check, then sanitization layer
Search index, then prompt, then policy check, then model context injection, then audit logging
Prompt directly to the model with the index attached as a tool, then sanitization of the output

explanation: Retrieval Access Flow: Prompt → Policy Check → Search Index → Sanitization Layer → Model Context Injection. Jede Retrieval-Mechanik erzwingt Connector-Autorisierung, strukturierte Query-Filter, DLP/Labels und regionsgebundene Zugriffsregeln.

source.title: Design access controls for grounding data and model tuning
source.quote: Retrieval Access Flow: Prompt → Policy Check → Search Index → Sanitization Layer → Model Context Injection

prompt: A data scientist with production access adds a new dataset to a fine-tuning run and promotes the tuned model the same day. Which access requirements from the learning content are missing?

options.text: Segregated environments, approval workflows for new training datasets, verified lineage, security scanning of inputs, and restricted promotion
A larger GPU quota for the tuning job, a faster storage tier for the datasets, and a longer retention period for training logs
A public endpoint for the tuned model, a model card published to the catalog, and a notification to the data owner
Removal of sensitivity labels from the training data, a shared service account for the pipeline, and a weekly retraining schedule with auto-promotion

explanation: Model Tuning Access Requirements: getrennte Umgebungen, Freigabe-Workflows für neue Trainingsdaten, dokumentierte Lineage, Security-Scanning der Inputs, eingeschränkte Promotion-Rechte. Guardrails: Blocklists, Sanitization, automatische Reviews, Anomalie-Alerts.

source.title: Design access controls for grounding data and model tuning
source.quote: Restricted ability to promote new tuned models into production

prompt: A compliance team wants audit trails for data changes to capture the full text of every ingested document. What does the learning content say about what logs should capture?

options.text: Logs must capture metadata, not content, to avoid unnecessary exposure of sensitive information
Logs must store the complete document content so that auditors can review each ingested record
Logs should remain mutable so that ingestion errors can be corrected by the data owner later
Logs are required for model changes; data changes are covered by the catalog's lineage graph

explanation: Für Datenänderungen werden Ingestion, Schemaänderungen, Refresh-Zyklen, Label-Änderungen, Sanitization, regionsübergreifende Bewegungen und Zugriffe auditiert; Logs erfassen Metadaten statt Inhalte und sind unveränderlich, zeitgestempelt, rollenattribuiert und JSON-strukturiert.
